decisions.rationale: Declare the proposal goal of recording a short note before semantic classification. This documentation-only addition does not change or attest the capture implementation.
Declare recovery of hierarchy, addresses and quotations as a proposal obligation. No session recovery code changes or implementation coverage are asserted in this PR.
Declare identity and quotation preservation during refinement. The statement records the draft contract; this PR neither changes refinement behavior nor supplies execution evidence.
Declare the distinction between human quotations and agent interpretations. This is draft attribution intent, without implementation or human-approval attestation.
Declare structural and attribution diff fidelity, including revision preservation on unchanged edits. This documentation-only declaration does not claim verification of that behavior.
Declare that sketch approval, proposal preparation authorization and canonical acceptance have distinct subjects. No authority decision or approval state changes in this PR.
Declare the proposed bounded handoff from selected notes to an identified specification region. The end-to-end handoff remains a proposal obligation; no writer or canonical mutation is enabled.
Declare use of the existing recorded promotion and review boundaries for a future graph change. This addition neither accepts the proposal nor publishes canonical records.
